summary.text: Enrique Sanchez is a Democratic state representative who has represented Rhode Island House of Representatives District 9 since January 3, 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Sanchez earned a bachelor's degree in public relations from Rhode Island College in 2019.
His career experience includes working as a teacher.
